nina: heads up, onboarding HF model x-neo-parked. small dataset, quant 4-bit produced weird chat drift after ~1k tokens.
maya: what kind of drift? prompt truncation? special tokens being swallowed?
nina: responses start repeating system instructions. traced to tokenizer + config mismatch. HF config had max_position_embeddings: 2048, sliding_window: true, rope_scaling: {"factor":0.5}, num_key_value_heads: 32
aj: send the converted redwood config snippet
nina: pasted: ```json
{"max_position_embeddings":1024,"sliding_window":false,"rope_scaling":null,"num_key_value_heads":16}
```
liam: aha — conversion clobbered max_pos and dropped rope_scaling -> kv head mismatch. that will corrupt kv cache indexing at >1024 tokens
maya: also check special token ids mapping. HF had <|sys|> at id 1, converter mapped it to 50256 by accident.
aj: run eval-bot small repro? eval-bot: queued eval job 4832 for thread 1718012345 — will run LMQL prompt set and report logits diff
nina: quick triage commands I ran:
```
python tools/convert_hf.py --input model/config.json --output redwood/config.json --map-special-tokens
python tests/tokenizer_check.py --hf tokenizer.json --redwood redwood_tokenizer.json
```
maya: patch idea: keep HF max_position_embeddings if > default, preserve rope_scaling object and scale kv heads rather than dropping
liam: I can throw a unit that fails conversion when special token id changes by >100
nina: for now rolling back to host model v1.2 (pre-conversion) and limiting requests to 900 tokens until fix.
aj: thanks. can someone open an RFC-ish PR describing the desired mapping rules? I'll champion.
maya: filing now -> #PR 786: 'hf->redwood config preserve rope/maxpos/special-token-ids'
nina: thanks all :thumbsup:
